quantities: Per LP-P0 concept prototype; alternatives are not additive. Use the selected PCB revision's assembly and harness BOMs for purchasing. No price or stock guarantee.

items.note: 5 V, 1.8 A nominal, 9 W; integrated bridge, class 0. Do not substitute the 12 V variant.
Order Ag97005-FL separately; compatibility is explicit on the manufacturer page. DATA OUT connects to WIZ850io. The evaluation board is excluded from the compact CAD.
Synchronous 5 V to 3.3 V buck. Advertised 2.6 A is typical at 24 V input; validate 1.5 A at 5 V input. Do not substitute an LDO.
Bare module, 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM. Bench: existing N16R8 DevKit only after USB-UART, LED and power isolation checks.
4 MB flash, separate Thread RCP. Verify the bench DevKitM-1 flash size and isolate its USB-UART TX from GPIO23.
10 dBm, internal antenna. Exact-pin Ember NCP and UART bootloader build recipe in firmware/low-power/mg24 passes offline checks; SWD programming and hardware validation remain required.
SPI Ethernet module with RJ45. No PoE center-tap headers. Mechanical section says 25 by 23 mm; feature section says 20 by 25 mm. Verify the drawing.
3.3 V only; retain the regional antenna. Inspect board revision, pin 7 reset function and physical dimensions before mounting.

items.model: Existing CC1101 433.92 MHz module with SMA antenna
items.note: Must expose GDO2. The chip datasheet does not define the existing module header or dimensions. Retain the 433 MHz antenna.
5 V supply, 3.3 V UART. Reuse a matching cable; never infer wire order from color.
External ventilated pod; 3.3 V VIN; I2C address 0x77; onboard pull-ups.
TSSOP28 UART expander. SPI mode 0, maximum 4 MHz; the current driver uses 4 MHz. Channel A runs at 115200 baud. Bare IC requires a bench adapter.
SC16 reset supervisor, 3.07 V threshold; CT open gives 20 ms; MR has an internal pull-up; add local 100 nF bypass.
18 pF load, 180 ohm ESR. Clock prescaler 1 and divisor 2. Measure oscillation, startup and baud rate.
Across the PD 5 V output. Include the installed EvalPoE capacitor in the 47 to 470 uF allowance; do not blindly double it.
PD output local filter; inspect EvalPoE population.
Assembly allowance for local IC/module power entry bypassing. Do not duplicate installed module capacitors automatically; count after layout.
3.3 V rail bulk capacitor; validate buck startup, stability and transient response.
XTAL1 to GND; initial NXP example value. Tune for the selected 18 pF crystal and stray capacitance.
XTAL2 to GND; initial NXP example value, not validated for the final PCB.
S3 EN and H2 EN startup RC networks; confirm rise time and reset sequencing.
Supervisor SENSE to GND.
GDO0 to 3.3 V; required for open-drain TX and release during receive.
IRQ to 3.3 V; value specified by NXP, not 10 kohm.

Pull-ups: three SPI CS signals, H2 EN, H2 BOOT, H2 GPIO8, SC16 RESET, unused RXB, S3 EN and S3 BOOT. Pull-down: H2 GPIO25. MG24 PA00 BOOT pull-up uses the twelfth resistor; no spare. Omit duplicates already installed on boards.
Unused SC16 GPIO0 through GPIO7 to GND. Avoid a hard short if a pin is later configured as an output.

items.model: Adafruit 4397 QT 4-pin to female sockets, 150 mm
items.note: BME cable: 150 mm is its total length, not its reach outside the case.

items.model: Short Cat5e four-pair RJ45 patch lead
items.note: EvalPoE DATA OUT to WIZ850io. One external PoE cable; no internal switch.
Select the footprint before ordering. Place crystal and supervisor locally; avoid long breadboard clock wires.

items.model: 2x5 SWD service header, 1.27 mm pitch, and compatible 3.3 V probe
items.note: Expose MG24 SWCLK, SWDIO, RESETn, GND and VTref. Assign the header pinout and verify it against the probe before connecting. Also expose PA00/pad7 BOOT and GND as a separate service jumper; hold low through reset to enter XMODEM bootloader.

items.model: Locking 5 V/GND power distribution, >=2 A per contact, <=0.05 ohm whole loop
items.note: Exact housing and wire length depend on bench or PCB assembly. Mark polarity and coordinate the fuse with wire gauge; no Dupont lead for the distribution trunk.

items.model: 1.5 A time-delay fuse and rated holder
items.note: Candidate for the 5 V secondary distribution. Validate cold start, I-squared-t and wire gauge. PD short-circuit protection does not validate branch wiring.
S3 BOOT, S3 RESET and MG24 RESET. MG24 RESET only sinks to GND; no external 3.3 V pull-up.

items.model: Single-host PCB option: LP-C0 backplane or LP-I0 integrated board
items.note: Original 160x100 mm reservation is superseded by the selected board revision. LP-C0 is 160x100 mm, 2 layers; LP-I0 is 160x142 mm, 4 layers. Use native CAD, verification reports and per-board BOMs; neither board is physically validated.

gates: Select one PCB revision and use its assembly/harness BOMs; this conceptual list is not an additive shopping cart.
LP-C0 uses a separate isolated PoE front end and WIZ850io; LP-I0 uses its own specified magjack and PD circuit. Isolation, DFM and first-article acceptance remain required.
Validate power leads, fuse derating, wire gauge and voltage drop on the actual assembly.
MG24 requires SWD programming and hardware validation; simultaneous radio operation is unverified.
Inspect the exact reused ZAC93, CC1101 and radar connector revisions before making their cable ends.
